2609.00082.title: KItCAT: Knowledge Injection via Input Corruption for Auto-regressive Training
2609.00082.paper_summary: LLMs acquire vast amounts of knowledge during pre-training, but often lack the specialized knowledge needed to answer questions from niche sources such as manuals or technical documents unseen during pre-training. Continued pre-training (CPT) is widely used to inject such knowledge into model parameters. However, niche documents seldom repeat facts, making it difficult for CPT to robustly acquire such knowledge. Recent works address this by generating multiple paraphrases of the new knowledge, but paraphrasing is computationally expensive and typically requires powerful LLMs. In this work, we introduce KItCAT: Knowledge Injection via Corrupted Auto-regressive Training, a lightweight training strategy that reduces the need for paraphrasing in decoder-only LLMs. KItCAT augments standard next-token prediction by stochastically corrupting the input sequence. During training, a random subset of input tokens is replaced with other vocabulary tokens while the original next-token labels are kept unchanged. This simple intervention generates diverse training inputs from each sample, enabling large-scale data augmentation at negligible cost. We show that KItCAT consistently improves over CPT across multiple datasets and model families. Code is available at https://github.com/meghanadhpulivarthi/KItCAT.
2609.00082.paper_summary_zh: LLMs 在預訓練期間獲得大量知識，但通常缺乏回答來自小眾來源（如手冊或技術文件）問題所需的專業知識，這些來源在預訓練期間未曾見過。持續預訓練（CPT）被廣泛用來將這些知識注入模型參數。然而，小眾文件很少重複事實，使得 CPT 難以穩健地獲取這些知識。最近的研究通過生成新知識的多個同義句來解決這個問題，但同義句生成的計算成本高且通常需要強大的 LLM。本文中，我們介紹 KItCAT：通過損壞自回歸訓練進行知識注入，這是一種輕量級訓練策略，減少了在僅解碼器 LLM 中進行同義句生成的需求。KItCAT 通過隨機損壞輸入序列來增強標準的下一個標記預測。在訓練過程中，隨機選擇的一部分輸入標記被其他詞彙標記替換，而原始的下一個標記標籤保持不變。這一簡單的干預從每個樣本生成多樣化的訓練輸入，使得在微不足道的成本下實現大規模數據增強。我們展示了 KItCAT 在多個數據集和模型系列上始終優於 CPT。代碼可在 https://github.com/meghanadhpulivarthi/KItCAT 獲得。
